clue.text: Detective type I've associated with era mistakenly

clue.text: Sign of approval of extremely practical check

parts.note: to audit accounts is to check them

explanation.surface: A nod of approval for a sensible inspection.

clue.text: Our inn — it's upset, getting unwelcome visit

clue.text: Investor's displeasure with switch of sides

clue.text: Boor, just starting, you are hearing out, obnoxious

clue.text: Cooked in London eatery

clue.text: Handy round protective device

clue.text: Core of team back from China?

clue.text: Car chart that's personally signed

explanation.definitionFit: A document in the author's own handwriting or bearing their own signature is described this way.

with 'taking', signals removal of the letter from the word

clue.text: Replica drink

clue.text: Thor's high point?

clue.text: Doing as expected of the French, proper, returning with useful tips

clue.text: Milky tea? Call for change
